description: City of Melbourne publishes the footprints of all structures within the City of Melbourne as 2D polygons of the base of each structure, where the walls meet the ground or podium, stacked vertically where the built form changes (tower, podium, setbacks); attributes include structure id, footprint type, roof type, minimum and maximum elevations against the Australian Height Datum and extrusion heights, and date captured. Coverage: the City of Melbourne municipality, Australia; about 41,700 polygons from a 2023 capture, record last modified on 2024-04-10; the portal also holds the 2018 and 2020 footprints and 2014 and 2015 building outlines. Format and access: CSV, JSON, GeoJSON, downloadable without registration from the City of Melbourne open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY; cost: free. Caveats: footprints are the wall base, not the roof outline; the polygons are stacked parts of structures, so a building can have several records. Simulation uses: building-level exposure and 2.5D geometry for flood, heat, wind and solar-access models, and change detection against the earlier footprint years. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap); Project PLATEAU: 3D city models of Japan (data-plateau-japan-3d-city-models).
